Update documents deliberate design decision changes rather allowing implementation guidance diverge. public serializer must cover every object supported base R serialization. Use dedicated native codecs common types whole-root R serialization rare unsupported types closures environments. Never embed independently R-serialized fallback fragments inside native object graph can break sharing cycles across codec boundary. Attributes part R value must preserved, including custom class-defining attributes. native codec may write object can preserve every attribute value; otherwise automatic mode must serialize complete root R serialization strict-native mode must reject . Never silently strip unknown unsupported attribute. Native .rdz files must expose bounded container information, object/schema descriptors, supported attribute values without materializing unrelated data vectors. Preserve seekable, checksummed object/attribute/block directory format first native version. Generic R-serialization payloads may expose clearly labeled synopsis; never claim exact arbitrary attribute access without fully unserializing root. External pointers native values. external pointer encountered root, list element, unknown/semantic attribute makes root ineligible native encoding selects whole-root R serialization automatic mode. exception explicitly registered, non-semantic, reconstructible attribute, data.table’s .internal.selfref; native adapter may omit attribute continue data-frame codec preserving c("data.table", "data.frame") class supported table metadata. Using data-frame codec physical-format choice, coercion base data frame. Never generalize exception silently dropping unknown external-pointer attributes. .rdz files must readable across supported Windows, macOS, Linux systems. title: Repository Guidelines
text: C99, four-space indentation, rdz_ internals .Call entry points, rdz_test_ test-entry points. core never includes R header allocates zubin’s zb_buf. Records zubin layout specifications (src/core/rdz_records.h) checked rdz_records_check(); read write zubin’s zb_rd_/zb_wr_ offsets, never struct. Every count, length offset file bounds-checked sizes allocation read. C never raises rdz error: failure returns rdz_failure string rdz_check() raises condition inheriting rdz_error. Heap state must survive longjmp hangs external pointer created first allocation, finalizer releases . R thread touches SEXPs calls R.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Name files test-*.R, helpers helper-*.R, use descriptive test_that() labels. R-side tests authoritative; C harness fuzz targets cover R-free core. Build double whose bits matter (-0, NaN payloads) bytes function test calls : R’s byte compiler folds literal -0 +0, value changes JIT compiles function, identical() tell (content hash can). Every API format change needs round-trip tests. Use expect_identical() ordinary values; use semantic graph/behavior assertions reference objects base R reconstructs rather preserving original identity, objects explicitly ignored transient metadata. Cover missing values, ordinary custom attributes, encodings, empty objects, reference sharing, boundary lengths, malformed input, automatic whole-root R-serialization fallback, strict-native rejection, temporary-file cleanup. format froze 0.1.0 (container-format.md, “Compatibility extension”): every later rdz reads frozen corpus (fixtures/v0.1.0/) values, never regenerated; addition gets new fixtures beside , changed meaning gets new version. Every -disk change must satisfy .agents/portability.md, update cross-OS fixtures bytes change, remain readable Windows, macOS, Linux CI matrix.

title: Using rdz
text: write_rdz() read_rdz() work saveRDS() readRDS() . Logical, integer, double character vectors, factors, lists data frames, nested attributes, stored natively: column column, checksummed blocks, vector encoding suits . Anything else (environment, function, model formula) goes R’s serializer blocks. Either way value comes back written. mode = "native" makes write_rdz() fail instead falling back, code relies selective reads, mode = "r" always uses R’s serializer.
code: path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rdz") write_rdz(mtcars, path) identical(read_rdz(path), mtcars) #> [1] TRUE fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars) write_rdz(fit, path) rdz_info(path)$codec #> [1] "r_serial_v3" all.equal(read_rdz(path), fit) #> [1] TRUE

title: Using rdz
text: Two options choose blocks stored, neither changes reader needs: setting reads file. "balanced" (default) compresses block Zstandard level 1; "compact" uses higher level; "speed" stores blocks uncompressed. options(rdz.threads = 4) compresses decompresses blocks four threads, file byte byte whatever number.
code: set.seed(1) sales <- data.frame(   day = as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:99999 %/% 100,   store = factor(sample(c("north", "south", "east", "west"), 1e5, TRUE)),   units = sample.int(50L, 1e5, TRUE),   price = round(runif(1e5, 1, 100), 2) )  sizes <- sapply(c("speed", "balanced", "compact"), function(preset) {   old <- options(rdz.preset = preset)   on.exit(options(old))   write_rdz(sales, path)   file.size(path) }) rds <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds") saveRDS(sales, rds) c(sizes, saveRDS = file.size(rds)) #>    speed balanced  compact  saveRDS  #>   917817   278811   278721   425618

title: Using rdz
text: rdz_info() reads header directory, never data. rdz_schema() lists native file’s tree, part’s class, shape, attributes stored size. rdz_attributes() reads attributes part, given path tree names positions, without decoding part’s data. Files can also carry key-value metadata, source code version, rdz_info() returns without reading value.
code: report <- list(sales = sales, note = "Q1", models = list(fit = coef(fit))) write_rdz(report, path) rdz_schema(path) #> <rdz_schema> native_v1 #>   <root>: list 3  (277,237 B)  [names] #>     $sales: data.frame 100000 x 4  (277,123 B)  [names, row.names, class] #>       $day: Date 100000  (453 B)  [class] #>       $store: factor 100000  (25,046 B)  [levels, class] #>       $units: integer 100000  (75,008 B) #>       $price: numeric 100000  (176,568 B) #>     $note: character 1  (7 B) #>     $models: list 1  (67 B)  [names] #>       $fit: numeric 2  (49 B)  [names] rdz_attributes(path, object = c("sales", "store")) #> $levels #> [1] "east"  "north" "south" "west"  #>  #> $class #> [1] "factor" rdz_attributes(path, object = c("models", "fit")) #> $names #> [1] "(Intercept)" "wt" write_rdz(sales, path, metadata = c(source = "pos-export", version = "2026.10")) rdz_info(path)$metadata #>       source      version  #> "pos-export"    "2026.10"

code: rdz_info(path)$content_hash #> [1] "88b0d26b25185e5fdef96ff365608910" rdz_hash(sales) #> [1] "88b0d26b25185e5fdef96ff365608910" before <- file.mtime(path) Sys.sleep(1) write_rdz(sales, path, skip_unchanged = TRUE,           metadata = c(source = "pos-export", version = "2026.10")) identical(file.mtime(path), before) #> [1] TRUE rdz_verify(path, content = TRUE)  damaged <- readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path)) damaged[200] <- xor(damaged[200], as.raw(0xff)) # one flipped byte writeBin(damaged, path) rdz_verify(path) #> Error: #> ! invalid rdz file: block 2 header does not match the directory

title: Versioned Serialization for R Objects
text: rdz writes reads R objects versioned, seekable, checksummed block container. Common objects stored natively, column column block block, compressed Zstandard pool threads; everything else goes R’s serializer, streamed blocks. Native: logical, integer, double character vectors, factors, lists data frames (data.table tibble included), nested, attributes: names, classes, Date’s POSIXct’s metadata, matrix’s dimensions. vector picks block records (runs, frame reference, delta, byte planes, sparse bitplane logicals, string dictionaries). Generic: anything else, environments, closures, calls, complex raw vectors, S4 objects, goes R serialization one whole root, sharing references kept. Selective: read_rdz(path, select = , rows = ) reads columns data frame elements list, rows data frame elements vector, decoding blocks need. Inspectable: rdz_schema() shows native file’s tree (part’s type, class, shape, attributes size), rdz_attributes(path, object = c("sales", "date")) reads part’s attributes, without decoding data. Content-addressed: every file records 128-bit hash value (rdz_info(path)$content_hash, read without data), rdz_hash(x) gives hash object, whatever preset, threads platform. write_rdz(skip_unchanged = TRUE) leaves file holding value , rdz_verify() checks file’s integrity without building . Compact graphs: large vector appears twice object stored read back shared, pickle Kryo . Archives: rdz_save(, b, file = ) rdz_load(file, names = "b") work save() load() , load objects named. memory: rdz_serialize(x) gives bytes raw vector (Redis, database, socket) rdz_unserialize() reads back; every reader takes raw vector takes path. Self-describing: write_rdz(x, path, metadata = c(source = "...")) records key-value strings rdz_info() reads without data. Tables written: data.tables come back usable place, nested , tibbles tibbles. Checked: every header, directory block carries XXH3-64 checksum, every length offset bounded anything allocated. Portable: files byte-identical every platform, little- big-endian alike.
